verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's own changelog lists "Secret variables in environments," which is a first-party capability aimed at masking credentials. It is only a one-line mention, with no detail on whether secrets are masked in the UI or kept out of synced, exported or shared workspace files, and there is no evidence of any external vault integration. Missing for 10: documented masking behavior, assurance that secrets are excluded from shared/exported environments, external vault integration (e.g. HashiCorp Vault/cloud secret managers), independent or hands-on corroboration.
